paragraphs: The 340i first appeared in the F30/F31 generation from 2015, replacing the previous 335i. It uses the B58 — BMW's 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine, a thoroughly modern unit that proved significantly more reliable than its predecessor. From 2019, the 340i name continued into the G20/G21 generation, but the car was rebadged as the M340i xDrive, gaining a 48V mild-hybrid system in the 2024 update. The B58 remains the engine across both generations — though the later cars have a different electrical architecture and additional components.
about.boldParagraph: The 340i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol fitted to the 340i from 2015 to 2019. Well-regarded for its reliability, with no significant defect pattern confirmed.
The same engine family but in a later-generation application, gaining 48V mild-hybrid assistance from the 2024 update. Generally well-regarded.
